lessons.title: Introduction to the Course: Practical Usage – Level 3.1 – Long Put
lessons.contentHtml:
Welcome to Level 3.1, focused on the practical usage of long put strategies. This course is designed for traders who have completed Levels 1, 2 and 3 and understand put options from the buyer's perspective.

What to Expect

  • Detailed case studies: Follow long put trades from setup and execution through monitoring and closing.
  • Position management: Adjust positions as the market moves, mitigate risk and lock in profits.
  • Trade analysis: Evaluate performance, market signals and the decisions behind each trade.
  • Risk management: Identify, assess and manage the risks inherent in long put strategies.

The module is designed to provide hands-on experience with long puts in real trading scenarios.
